item.title: Miami Marathon Afterparty at Ironside Miami
item.description: Miami, FL - January 26, 2026 - Red Bull and New Balance hosted a Miami Marathon after-party at Miami Ironside, bringing runners, supporters, and the local community together following race day. Held in the Longevity District, the celebration blended music, culture, and post-race energy, giving marathon finishers a space to celebrate their accomplishment while tapping into Miami’s creative scene. item.title: WRE News: Miami Surpasses New York as the U.S. Capital of Million-Dollar Homes
item.description: Miami, FL - January 26, 2026 - Miami has officially overtaken New York as the nation’s epicenter of million-dollar homes, signaling a dramatic shift in where luxury real estate is concentrating. By the end of 2025, Miami surpassed New York City in active $1 million-plus listings, with 10,591 luxury properties on the market compared to New York’s 10,176, according to Realtor.com.
